title: When exactly was the play over?
summary: Devonte Wyatt’s personal foul extended a Detroit possession during a 20–17 Green Bay loss. Players disputed whether the play had ended; the referee said it had.

timeline.label: Third quarter
timeline.text: Amon-Ra St. Brown returned to his feet during a tackle sequence.

timeline.label: The flag
timeline.text: Wyatt tackled him as umpire Terry Killens Jr. entered the action and fell.

timeline.label: Two plays later
timeline.text: Detroit scored a touchdown to lead 17–14.

unusual: The dispute turns on the distinction between a play being ruled dead and players hearing a whistle.
explanations: The referee’s pool-report explanation and the players’ accounts disagree on the live-play perception. Team reporting supplies both accounts, but is not independent adjudication.
questions: Was the whistle audible to the players? No league reversal was located in this review.

sources.label: Packers: player accounts and referee pool report
